DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の表示についてのご質問ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tanong po sa nakalagay sa passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここに十八万円とあるので、今も十八万円を使えると思いました。現金を十五万円出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金額を現残高と思い希望引出額を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. May 180,000 yen rito, kaya akala ko 180,000 pa rin ang magagamit. Gusto kong mag-withdraw ng 150,000 yen cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipagkamali ang deposito bilang balanse at sabihin ang gustong kunin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字は入金の欄です。現在の残高と、後に記録された取引を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Deposito ang kolum na iyan. Tingnan ang kasalukuyang balanse at sumunod na mga transaksiyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次の行に家賃六万円の引落しがあります。この入金だけを残高だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後の家賃引落しを示し入金欄の読み違いを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa susunod na linya, may 60,000 yen na kaltas sa upa. Itong deposito lang ang akala kong balanse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ituro ang kasunod na upa at itama ang pagbasa ng deposito. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入金額と、その後の取引を反映した残高は別ですね。最新の記録も担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Magkaiba ang deposito at balanseng kasama ang sumunod na transaksiyon. Titingnan din ang pinakabagong tala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今あると確認できた金額で考えます。通帳のこのページだけで十五万円を出せるとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認済み残高で考えページだけで引出可能と決めないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Batay sa natiyak na naroon ngayon ang iisipin ko. Hindi ako magpapasiyang makakakuha ng 150,000 sa pahinang ito lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Gamitin ang natiyak na balanse, huwag magpasya sa pahina lang. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お引き出しのご希望と、残高の確認を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hiwalay naming itatanong ang nais kunin at pagtitiyak ng balanse.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の買い物もありますが、通帳にはまだ載っていません。頭の中の計算だけではなく、最新の記録で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未記帳の買物を補足し最新の取引で確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: May pamimili rin kahapon, pero hindi pa nasa passbook. Gusto kong tiyakin sa bagong tala, hindi kuwenta sa isip lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Idagdag ang di-nailimbag na pamimili at ipatsek ang bagong transaksiyon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未記帳の取引がある可能性も含めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titingnan kasama ang posibilidad na may di-pa-nailimbag na transaksiyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。確認後に引き出す額を決めます。給与十八万円の行は、そのまま今の残高として家族へ伝えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に引出額を決め家族へ入金額を残高として知らせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Pagkatapos suriin, pipiliin ang halaga. Hindi ko sasabihin sa pamilya na kasalukuyang balanse ang linyang sahod na 180,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pumili pagkatapos suriin at huwag sabihin sa pamilya ang deposito bilang balanse. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の確認をして、最新の記録とお引き出しについて担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Titiyakin ang pagkakakilanlan at dadalhin sa nakatalaga para sa bagong tala at withdrawal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札の確認でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。このコーヒーは、ここに書いてある値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持っている商品の価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Ito ba ang nakasulat na presyo ng kapeng ito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang presyo ng hawak na produkto. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 値札の商品名と容量をご覧ください。お持ちのものは何グラムですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan ang pangalan at dami sa tag. Ilang gramo ang hawak?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二百グラムです。値札は百五十グラムと書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品と値札の容量差を読み上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Dalawang daang gramo. Isang daan at limampung gramo ang tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Basahin ang pagkakaiba ng dami sa produkto at tag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その値札は隣の商品用です。こちらが二百グラムの表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Para sa katabing produkto ang tag. Ito ang label ng dalawang daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じメーカーなので、同じ値段だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じメーカーなら同額だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Akala ko parehong presyo dahil parehong tagagawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang akalang parehong tagagawa, parehong presyo. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容量や種類が違いますので、表示をそれぞれ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Iba ang dami at uri, kaya tingnan ang bawat label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予算に合わせて、百五十グラムのほうに替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予算に合う小さい商品へ替えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong palitan ng isang daan at limampung gramo ayon sa badyet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humiling ng mas maliit na pasok sa badyet. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品名と容量が、先ほどの値札に合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tugma ang pangalan at dami nito sa tag kanina.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二百グラムの品は元に戻し、こちらを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大きい商品を戻して合う品を買うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ibabalik ang dalawang daang gramo at ito ang bibilhin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibalik ang malaki at bilhin ang tugma. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。取り違えに気づいたので、会計前に確認できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Mabuti at napansing napagpalit bago magbayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆さんで写真を撮られるのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この道の中央なら全員入ります。少し通行を止めてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合写真のため通行を止められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Kasya lahat sa gitna ng daang ito. Puwede bang pahintuin sandali ang dumaraan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung puwedeng pahintuin ang daan para sa grupo. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ほかの方が通れるようにご利用ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 後ろに人が写るので、誰も通らない瞬間を待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人が写らない瞬間を待ちたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: May tao sa likod sa litrato, kaya hihintayin ang sandaling walang dumaraan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang paghintay na walang taong nasa larawan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場合も道をふさがず、端で待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kahit ganoon, sa gilid maghintay at huwag harangan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 撮る人だけ道の反対側に立つと、間を人が通りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道を挟む配置の問題に気づいて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kung photographer lang ang sa kabilang gilid, may dadaan sa pagitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mapansin at sabihin ang problema ng magkabilang gilid. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 離れて道を挟む配置では、通行を妨げないよう注意が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung magkahiwalay sa magkabilang daan, ingatang hindi humarang sa pagdaan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全員が同じ側に移動して、木を背景にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ側へ移り木を背景にすると提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong lahat ay sa parehong panig, mga puno ang background.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Imungkahing lumipat sa parehong panig at puno ang likod. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場所なら、まず通路の幅を確保できるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa lugar na iyon, tingnan muna kung may sapat na lapad ng daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人数を二列にして、道にはみ出さずに撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二列に並び通路にはみ出さず撮ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Dalawang hanay kami at kukuha nang hindi nakausli sa daan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang dalawang hanay nang hindi lumalampas sa daan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。撮影が終わったら、機材も速やかにまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11243-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Pagkatapos, iligpit agad pati kagamitan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧になっていますね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この矢印のホームへ行けば、目的地までそのまま行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 矢印のホームから直通で行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Kung pupunta sa platform ng palasong ito, diretso na sa destinasyon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung diretso mula sa platform ng palaso. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 矢印はどの区間の案内でしょうか。お持ちの経路を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Aling seksiyon ang tinutukoy? Pakita ang ruta ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに乗り換えの駅もあります。でも私は矢印だけを見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗換駅を見落としていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: May transfer station din dito, pero palaso lang ang tiningnan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na di-napansin ang transfer station. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内は、まず乗換駅までの区間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Para muna sa seksiyon hanggang transfer station ang gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、そこに着いた後に、別のホームへ移るんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中でホームを移る必要があると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kaya pagdating doon, lilipat sa ibang platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyaking kailangang lumipat ng platform sa gitna. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。最終目的地まで一本という意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo. Hindi ibig sabihin isang tren hanggang pinakahuli.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗換駅の名前をメモしたいので、読み方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗換駅名の読み方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itatala ko ang pangalan ng transfer station, paano basahin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagbasa ng transfer station. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの駅名です。次の区間の行き先も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itong pangalan. Tiyakin din natin ang destinasyon ng kasunod na seksiyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初の列車と、乗り換えた後の行き先を分けて覚えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最初と次の区間を分けて理解したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hiwalay kong tatandaan ang unang tren at destinasyon pagkatapos lumipat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hiwalay na naunawaan ang una at kasunod. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で進んでください。途中で迷ったら案内を見せて尋ねられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sundin ang ayos na iyon. Kung malito, ipakita ang gabay at magtanong.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 必要な証明書の申請でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「住民票の写し」とあるので、家にある紙をコピーしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証明書の名称にある写しが自宅コピーでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. “Kopya ng resident record” ang nakasulat, puwedeng i-photocopy ang papel sa bahay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung ang kopya sa pangalan ay puwedeng home photocopy. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その「写し」は、証明書の名称として使われている言葉です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ang “kopya” ay salita sa pangalan ng sertipiko.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普通のコピーという意味ではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名称と普通のコピーの違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya hindi karaniwang photocopy ang ibig sabihin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pangalan laban sa karaniwang photocopy. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。提出先が求めるものと、手元の紙が何かを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Tiyakin ang hinihingi ng pagsusumitan at kung ano ang papel ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手元の紙は、以前もらった証明書を自分でコピーしたものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手元にある紙の作り方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Photocopy ko mismo ng dati kong natanggap na sertipiko ang papel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag kung paano ginawa ang hawak na papel. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのコピーでよいかは、提出先の条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung tanggap iyon ay depende sa kondisyon ng pagsusumitan; pakitiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しく発行されたものが必要と書いてあります。申請したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい発行が必要という条件と申請希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nakasulat na bagong inilabas ang kailangan. Nais kong mag-apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang kundisyong bagong inilabas at kahilingang mag-apply. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、記載内容や必要な人数などを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung gayon, titiyakin ang nilalaman at kung ilang tao ang kailangan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前だけで判断せず、案内にある条件を見ながらお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先の案内を基に内容確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi lang pangalan ang batayan; tingnan ang kondisyon sa gabay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipatsek ang nilalaman batay sa gabay ng pagsusumitan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内書もこちらへお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Pakita rin ang gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後のご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「経過を見てください」と言われました。もう来なくていいという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 経過を見るという言葉が受診終了を意味するか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Sabi “obserbahan ang pag-usad”. Ibig sabihin hindi na kailangang bumalik?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung pag-obserba ay katapusan ng pagpapatingin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その言葉だけでは、次の受診が不要とは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa salitang iyon lang, hindi masasabing hindi na kailangan ang susunod.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いつまで、何を見ればいいのか分かりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察する期間と内容が分からないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko alam hanggang kailan at ano ang oobserbahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing di-malinaw ang panahon at nilalaman ng pagmamasid. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 具体的な指示は、診察した担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin ang tiyak na utos sa tumingin sa inyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付の方に日数を決めていただくことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付が日数を決められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Puwede bang reception ang magtakda ng ilang araw?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong kung reception ang makapagtatakda ng araw. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで診療の指示を決めることはできません。確認したい内容を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hindi kami magtatakda ng medikal na utos. Ipapasa ang nais tiyakin sa nakatalaga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次の受診日と、変化があった時の連絡先を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当に次の受診日と連絡先を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong itanong ang susunod na pagbisita at contact kung may pagbabago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipatsek sa nakatalaga ang susunod na pagbisita at contact. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二点を確認しますので、少しお待ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。分からないまま、受診は終わりだと思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に受診終了と解釈しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Hindi ko iisiping tapos na ang pagbisita habang di ko alam.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi ituturing tapos bago matiyak. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。確認できた説明を聞いてからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Makinig sa natiyak na paliwanag bago umuwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような連絡がありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 応募した会社の名前で、今日中に身分証の写真を送るよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 身分証写真を急いで送るよう求められたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa pangalan ng kumpanyang inaplayan, pinasend ang ID photo bago matapos ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang agarang paghingi ng ID photo. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 応募時に使った連絡先と同じですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 似ていますが、メールアドレスの文字が一つ違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 応募先と似た別アドレスだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Magkahawig pero isang character ng email ang iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing ibang address na kahawig ng inaplayan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いに気づいたのですね。写真は送りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Napansin ninyo ang kaibhan. Naipadala na ang larawan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。応募したことを知っているので、本物かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未送信だが応募情報で信用しそうだったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa. Alam niyang nag-apply ako, kaya muntik akong maniwalang totoo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa, pero halos naniwala dahil sa impormasyon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 応募の情報を知っていることだけで、送信元は確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hindi sapat ang pagkaalam ng application upang matiyak ang nagpadala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メールにある番号ではなく、応募の控えにある窓口へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 応募時の既知の窓口で確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa contact sa application copy ko titiyakin, hindi sa numero sa email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing sa kilalang contact noong application titiyakin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡の内容と、二つのアドレスを残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itabi ang nilalaman at dalawang address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返信は止めて、身分証の写真も送らずに確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返信と画像送信を止めて確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Titigil sa reply at titiyakin nang hindi ipinapadala ang ID photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing titigil sa reply at larawan bago tiyakin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。相手から新たな要求が来た場合も、記録してご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Kung may bagong hiling, itala at ikonsulta rin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の中身を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maaari bang itanong ang laman ng padala?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カップです。箱に「割れ物」と書けば、緩衝材はいりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注意書きがあれば緩衝材を省けるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mga tasa. Kung isulat “babasagin” sa kahon, hindi na kailangan ng cushioning?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung babala ay sapat upang alisin ang cushioning. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注意の表示と、中身の保護は別です。箱の中で動きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Iba ang babala at proteksiyon ng laman. Gumagalaw ba sa loob?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隙間があって、傾けるとカップ同士が当たります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱の隙間でカップがぶつかると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: May puwang at nagbabanggaan ang tasa kapag itinagilid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang banggaan dahil sa puwang. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままでは中身がぶつかる状態ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kaya nagbabanggaan ang laman sa kasalukuyang balot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙を一枚挟むだけで、割れないと保証できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 簡単な仕切りで破損を防げる保証があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Isang papel lang sa pagitan, magagarantiyang hindi mababasag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong kung simpleng divider ay garantiya laban sa sira. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで破損しないと保証することはできません。十分な梱包を考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hindi namin magagarantiyang hindi masisira. Isaalang-alang ang sapat na balot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つずつ包んで、隙間も埋め直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個別包装と隙間の詰め直しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong balutin bawat isa at punuin muli ang puwang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humiling ng hiwalay na balot at muling pagpuno ng puwang. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送前に見直すなら、まだ受付を進めずにお待ちできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung rerepasuhin bago ipadala, puwedeng maghintay nang hindi pa ipoproseso ang pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち帰って梱包を直します。表示だけに頼らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送を保留して梱包を直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iuuwi at aayusin ang balot. Hindi aasa sa label lamang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang pagpapadala at ayusin ang balot. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。外箱も含めて状態を確認してからお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Tiyakin pati labas na kahon bago dalhin muli.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みについてのご相談ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会費ですが、保存してある口座と、この紙の口座が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存口座と紙の口座が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Membership fee, pero iba ang saved account sa nasa papel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing iba ang saved account at nasa papel. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい口座の案内は、どちらから受け取ったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Saan galing ang bagong account information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付でもらいました。ただ、去年の紙か今年の紙か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内を受け取った場所と年度の不明点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa reception. Pero hindi ko alam kung papel ng nakaraang taon o ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pinanggalingan at hindi malinaw na taon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付や対象期間を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Makikita ang petsa o saklaw na panahon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付が切れて読めません。銀行で正しいほうを選んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読めない日付を伝えて銀行が選べるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Putol ang petsa kaya di-mabasa. Puwedeng bangko ang pumili ng tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang di-mabasang petsa at itanong kung bangko ang pipili. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会費の振込先としてどちらが正しいかは、こちらでは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hindi namin maipapasya kung alin ang tamang account ng membership fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会の窓口に、今年の支払いに使う口座を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会の窓口へ今年の振込先を確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Titiyakin ko sa samahan ang account para sa bayad ngayong taon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing titiyakin sa samahan ang ngayong taong padadalhan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで、古い保存先をそのまま使わないようご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Huwag gamitin basta ang lumang saved recipient hanggang matiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。新しいという思い込みもせず、今年の案内を取り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を取り直し新旧を思い込まず確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi ko rin ipapalagay na bago; kukuha muli ng gabay ngayong taon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Kumuha muli ng gabay at huwag ipalagay bago o luma. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのうえで、名義や番号を一つずつ照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Pagkatapos, isa-isang ihambing ang account name at numero.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の画面でお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。支払い方法を選ぶ画面まで進みましたが、牛乳を追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払い画面から商品を追加したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Nasa pagpili na ako ng paraan ng bayad, pero gusto kong magdagdag ng gatas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing magdadagdag mula sa payment screen. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お支払いは、まだ完了していませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。カードも入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カード未使用で支払い前だと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa. Hindi ko rin naipasok ang card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Linawing hindi nagamit ang card at bago magbayad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、画面の状態を確認します。商品を取りに行く間は、そのまま離れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ang screen. Huwag basta iwan habang kukuha ng produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に支払って、戻ってから同じ会計に追加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払い後に同じ会計へ追加できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Puwedeng magbayad muna at idagdag sa parehong checkout pagbalik?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagdagdag sa parehong checkout pagkatapos magbayad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払いが完了すると、今の会計に追加する扱いとは別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kapag bayad na, ibang proseso sa pagdagdag sa kasalukuyang checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ確定していない今の段階で、追加できるか見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確定前の画面で追加の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong ipatsek kung puwedeng idagdag ngayon habang hindi pa final.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipatsek ang pagdagdag bago final ang screen. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで操作を確認しますので、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Pakihintay habang tinitingnan ang operasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 牛乳は一本です。画面を自分で何度も戻さずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加数量を伝えて店員の操作確認を待つと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Isang lalagyan ng gatas. Maghihintay nang hindi paulit-ulit na bumabalik sa screen mismo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang dami at hintayin ang kawani sa pagtitiyak ng operasyon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。確認が済んだら、追加する手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Pagkatapos suriin, ituturo ang pagdagdag.
